Text declaration: Primarily AI-generated.
The problem was chosen, and the work directed, by the submitter in sessions with Claude Code (Anthropic). The case analysis, the two search programs, the SAT encoding, the Lean 4 formalisation and the text were produced by AI systems. What is machine-checked: (1) every one of the 1080 SAT cubes was refuted by CaDiCaL 2.1.3 with an LRAT proof accepted by lrat-check (drat-trim commit 2e3b2dc); (2) the theorem MC222.mc_eq_seven : MC = 7 builds in Lean 4.36.0 with Mathlib v4.36.0, with axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound and 365 auxiliary axioms, one for each bv_decide or native_decide evaluation, so its trusted base is the Lean kernel together with the Lean compiler and runtime. What is proved on paper only: the reduction lemmas used by the two external programs (the Lean proof does not use them). All computations were reproduced on one machine and one toolchain; this shows determinism, not independent confirmation. Repository: https://github.com/xennygrimmato/math/tree/@COMMIT@
